2328→local function crackPanes(intensity)
  2329→	if state.windowBroken then return end
  2330→	for i=1,math.floor(6+10*intensity) do
  2331→		local x=rng:NextNumber(-52,52)
  2332→		local y=rng:NextNumber(32,69)
  2333→		local last=Vector3.new(x,y,93.72)
  2334→		for step=1,4 do
  2335→			local p=last+Vector3.new(rng:NextNumber(-2.8,2.8),
  2336→				rng:NextNumber(0.6,2),0)
  2337→			beam(glassScarFolder,"HAIRLINE_BOROSILICATE_CRACK",
  2338→				last,p,0.10,i%4==0 and C.orange or C.ivory,
  2339→					Enum.Material.Neon,0.24)
  2340→			last=p
  2341→		end
  2342→	end
